title: Boomite
body:
Description


Boomite is a common ore found on Ferwater Island in a specific cave found in the desert. It can only spawn in Terracotta nodes within the cave. Boomite appears as a dark blue crystal with blue smoke emanating on the node, but as soon as the player mines the piece off, it will turn a bright orange, with orange light and sparking particles emitting from it, along with a hissing sound similar to lighting an explosive.

About 10 minutes after it's mined, Boomite will explode, causing nearby players to take damage, moving objects, and the ore itself to disappear (does not damage walls of rocks).

When placed in Storage Drawers, it will not explode, however the timer continues and if the boomite is removed from the drawer it will still explode at 10 minutes from when it was mined. If it has been longer than 10 minutes, the boomite will immediately explode.

When refined or forged, Boomite will lose the ability to explode, and will return to its original blue color.

Boomite's profitability comes from how large its nodes are on average, therefore increasing stud volume, and also because of how common it is.

Trivia

  • Though being able to explode, Boomite ores are unable to damage or destroy destructible walls, ores, or rock nodes of any kind.
  • Ramming your car into the larger Boomite crystals in the cave will also cause them to turn orange, exploding after a few seconds. The explosion can fling vehicles, loose items, and damage players.
  • Chiseling Raw Boomite causes it to return to its blue coloration, however it will still explode.
  • Boomite (specifically refined) tends to fling people far into the air.
  • Upon forging Boomite, its name used to change to "boomite" (all lowercase).
    • This has since been fixed.
